title: Medieval Town time-lapse | Godot / GPT 6 / Fable 5.2
author: 2nd_breakfastt
selftext:
Hey guys here’s a small example of what building a settlement looks like in my game Valdmark!

Demo available here https://ynotved.itch.io/valdmark

Currently working on adding in mini games to the production lines and workshops: to make them more fun and exciting to use/automate, improve quality and/or amount of goods produced

Valdmark is a medieval sandbox RPG inspired by games like Rimworld and Kenshi and building up a settlement is just one way to play the game

With many different starting lives to choose from, you live the life you want in Valdmark

You can rent out a tavern in a big city, customize it and become master at crafting ales and beers which becomes known across the land, build your own smithing workshop and supply the mercenaries that travel the roads or become a lords right hand man for all their weaponry for wars, be a merchant trader making a fortune traveling to and from with your trusted mule, start out with a group of settlers, start out in a guild or a cult, the choices are endless 

My AI process: I used GPT-6 for brainstorming, game design, planning mechanics, and creating art references. Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2 handled the coding, implementing gameplay systems, and procedurally generating the artwork. The game itself is built in Godot, with Blender used to generate 3D models and assets.
